question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide?

claims.text: Digital photos meeting IRCC's permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided for the principal applicant, spouse or common-law partner, and dependent children.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The uploaded PDF document for opaque case ID bd9e0ba88f82848fc083628283b223c4 in upload slot digital_photo contains 2 pages of digital photo images submitted for Express Entry completeness review.
